As an action, you can rush up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, without provoking opportunity attacks. Every creature within 5 feet of your path must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your attack bonus with your weapon) or take your weapon's normal damage — half that damage on a success. If you're wielding two separate light or vibro weapons (one per hand) that you're proficient with, or a weapon with the double property, each save is made with disadvantage, and a creature that fails also takes extra damage equal to your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice, minimum 1), if that modifier isn't already included.

You must complete a short or long rest before using this feature again.
